## About
Dalco Air Conditioning & Heating Company is a family owned business with family values and friendly home town service. Ken Oringderff is our founder and president, and the family still works side by side to look after customers across Dallas and North Central Texas.
We install new systems and handle repairs and maintenance for homes and businesses. Our goal is simple: keep you cool in the summer and warm in the winter. Customers on Google rate us 4.3 from 43 reviews.
Our professionals are here to answer your questions. Call, come by or send us a message.

## Services
- Installation of new systems: New cooling and heating systems for residential, commercial and industrial customers.
- Repairs and maintenance: Repairs and upkeep for all air conditioning and heating systems, home or business.
- Basic Plan: Spring and fall maintenance: we check and adjust the thermostat, check refrigerant charge, clean condenser coils with water, inspect the heat exchanger, test for combustion gases and more. ($139.90)
- Premium Plan: Everything in the Basic Plan, plus condenser coil cleaning with cleaner, a condensate drain line cleaned with nitrogen and an anti-algae treatment. ($242.90)
- Germ protection: Germicidal lights, disinfecting fogging and expert duct cleaning for year round anti-germ protection.

## FAQ
Q: What do I get with a Dalco Comfort Plan?
A: Automatic on-time maintenance scheduling, priority scheduling of your service calls, and a 15% discount on all repairs.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We serve Dallas and North Central Texas.

Q: Can I finance a new system?
A: You can apply online to finance your new Lennox system.
